fields.title: Environments are separated, and production stays in production

sections.Purpose: We separate production from every environment below it, by access, by network and by credential. A change is checked before customers see it, and nothing outside production has access to production's data or its identity.
sections.Scope:
All environments hosting systems we build or operate, from a developer's machine through to production, including temporary and on-demand environments.

_Boundary: this policy states which environments are separated and what is prohibited from crossing between them. [pol-MEXP](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/f9d1e0eb7e9131b3e611efff0f7b61e7f1f7d292/examples/engineering/policies/security/mexp-minimised-exposure.md) owns the network segmentation that enforces it, under `SEGMENT`._
sections.Exceptions: Not every solution needs a full set of tiers. A reduced set is acceptable where the rationale is recorded and the production boundary itself is unaffected. Diagnosing a live incident in production is incident response, not development, and [pol-INCR](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/f9d1e0eb7e9131b3e611efff0f7b61e7f1f7d292/examples/engineering/policies/operations/incr-incident-response.md) governs it. `CREDS` and `REUSE` state a secrets prohibition that [pol-SCRT](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/f9d1e0eb7e9131b3e611efff0f7b61e7f1f7d292/examples/engineering/policies/security/scrt-secrets-management.md#clauses) owns and that admits no exception. Any other departure requires a recorded deviation under [pol-DEVI](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/f9d1e0eb7e9131b3e611efff0f7b61e7f1f7d292/examples/engineering/policies/governance/devi-deviations.md).
